projects.description: A ranking of the 10,000 most-starred GitHub repositories, refreshed every week. See how repositories climb and fall, which are new, and how many stars they gained since an earlier ranking.

projects.name: Wikidomains
projects.description: It transforms a Wikipedia domain (such as artificial intelligence, ancient Rome, or astrophysics) into a specific list of articles to track. It also provides a dashboard showing what is popular, what is gaining traction, what has been created recently, and where disputes are taking place.
